words.ex: Oh, I didn't know that.
words.en: used to express surprise, fear, joy, etc.

words.tr: n. （术语）武装部队的应征人员（贬义）
words.ex: The soldier called him an e-dog for joining the army only to get benefits.
words.ex_cn: 士兵称他为应征人员，说他参军只是为了获得福利。
words.en: An electronic device designed to mimic the behavior and functions of a real dog, providing companionship or entertainment.

words.tr:
n. 大师；主人；
v. 掌握；精通；
words.ex: He is a master of classical piano.
words.en: A master is someone who has control over something or someone; a person who is highly skilled in a particular area; or a degree awarded by a university or college.

words.ex: The hotel has a five-star grade.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店有五星级别的等级。
words.en: A grade is a level of quality, rank, or value, or a mark given in an examination or for school work.

words.ex: The student reads a book every day.
words.en: A student is a person who is studying at a university or college.

words.tr: n. 阅读；读物； v. 读；“read”的现在分词；
words.ex: Reading is an important skill for students.
words.ex_cn: 阅读是学生的重要技能。
words.en: The action or skill of reading written or printed matter silently or aloud.

words.ex: My classmate helped me with my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我的同班同学帮我做了作业。
words.en: A classmate is someone who is in the same class as you at school or college.

words.ex: I do my homework after school.
words.en: After school refers to the time period following the end of the school day.

words.tr: adj. 苗条的；纤细的；微小的；
words.ex: She has a slim figure.
words.en: If someone is slim, they are thin in an attractive way.

words.ex: He is good at math.
words.en: To have a natural ability or skill in a particular area.

words.tr:
prep. 遍于…之上；越过；
adv. 大于；结束；越过；
words.ex: The blanket is over the bed.
words.en: In addition to the meanings related to physical position or movement above something, 'over' can also indicate completion, excess, or repetition.

words.ex: There is a book on the table.
words.en: Used to indicate the place where someone or something is or where something happens.

words.ex: The students are sitting in the classroom.
words.en: A room in a school where lessons take place.

words.tr: n. 跳舞；舞蹈； v. 跳舞；“dance”的现在分词；
words.ex: Dancing is her favorite hobby.
words.ex_cn: 跳舞是她最喜欢的爱好。
words.en: the activity of moving your body in time to music

words.tr: n. 游泳；游泳运动； v. “swim”的现在分词；
words.ex: Swimming is good for your health.
words.en: the sport or activity of moving through water by moving your arms and legs

words.tr:
n. 年龄；时代；
v. 变老；
words.ex: His age is 25 years.
words.en: The length of time that a person has lived or a thing has existed.

words.tr:
v. 看上去；看；
n. 相貌；
words.ex: She looks happy today.
words.en: The appearance of someone or something, especially when it is attractive or interesting.

words.ex: The puppy is cute.
words.en: If you describe someone or something as cute, you mean that they are attractive, often in a childlike or youthful way.

words.ex: He reads books as a hobby.
words.en: A hobby is an activity that you enjoy doing in your spare time.

words.ex: I am glad to see you.
words.en: If you are glad about something, you are happy and pleased about it.

words.ex: Everyone likes ice cream.
words.en: You use everyone or everybody to refer to all the people in a particular group.

words.ex: He comes from a small village.
words.en: To originate or hail from a particular place or background.

words.tr: n. 眼镜；玻璃杯；“glass”的复数；
words.ex: He wears glasses to see the board clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他戴眼镜以便清楚地看到黑板。
words.en: Glasses are objects worn in front of the eyes to help people see better. They consist of a pair of lenses set in a frame that rests on the nose and ears.

words.tr: n. 步行； v. 步行；行走；“walk”的现在分词； adj. 步行的；
words.ex: Walking is good for your health.
words.en: Walking is the activity of going for a walk, especially for pleasure or exercise.

words.ex: He really loves his job.
words.ex_cn: 他真正地热爱他的工作。
words.en: You use really to emphasize that something is true or that it is the case.

words.ex: He ate soup from a bowl.
words.en: A bowl is a round container with a wide uncovered top. Some kinds of bowl are used, for example, for serving or eating food from, or in cooking, while other larger kinds are often used for washing or other purposes.

words.tr:
n. 时间；时期；次数；
v. 计时；安排时间；
words.ex: I don't have time to finish my homework.
words.en: Time is the ongoing sequence of existence and events that occurs in an apparently irreversible succession from the past, through the present, into the future.

words.ex: He plays tennis every weekend.
words.en: Tennis is a game played by two or four players on a rectangular court, in which a ball is hit back and forth over a net using rackets.

words.ex: He plays volleyball every Saturday.
words.en: A game played by two teams of six players in which a large ball is hit by hand over a high net, the aim being to score points by making the ball reach the ground on the opponent's side of the court.

words.ex: I enjoy eating ice cream on hot days.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢在热天吃冰淇淋。
words.en: If you enjoy something, you find pleasure and satisfaction in doing it or experiencing it.

words.ex: He goes swimming every weekend.
words.en: To engage in the activity of swimming, typically in a body of water such as a pool, lake, or ocean.

words.tr: n. 运动员；选手；唱机；玩家；
words.ex: The player scored a goal in the final minute.
words.ex_cn: 这名运动员在最后一分钟进了一球。
words.en: A player is someone who takes part in a game or sport, or someone who performs in a theatrical production or musical performance.

words.ex: He is a member of the school club.
words.ex_cn: 他是学校俱乐部的成员。
words.en: A member is a person who belongs to a group such as a club, organization, or team.

words.ex: He joins a chess club after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后加入了一个国际象棋俱乐部。
words.en: A club is an organization of people with a common purpose or interest, who meet regularly and take part in shared activities. It can also refer to a heavy stick used as a weapon or for hitting a ball in sports.

words.tr:
adj. 免费的；自由的；
adv. 免费地；自由地；
v. 释放；
words.ex: The museum offers free entry on Sundays.
words.ex_cn: 这个博物馆在周日免费入场。
words.en: If someone is free, they are able to do what they want to do, or go where they want to go, without being controlled or restricted.

words.tr:
v. 希望；
n. 希望；
words.ex: I hope it rains tomorrow.
words.en: If you hope that something is true, or if you hope for something, you want it to be true or to happen, and you usually believe that it is possible or likely.

words.tr:
n. 梦；梦想；
v. 梦想；做梦；
words.ex: I had a strange dream last night.
words.ex_cn: 我昨晚做了一个奇怪的梦。
words.en: A dream is a series of thoughts, images, and sensations occurring in a person's mind during sleep. It can also refer to a cherished aspiration, ambition, or ideal.

words.tr: adj. 真实的；真的；正确的；
words.ex: The story is true.
words.en: in accordance with fact or reality

words.ex: Her dream will come true next year.
words.ex_cn: 她的梦想明年将会实现。
words.en: If a dream, hope, or prediction comes true, it actually happens.

words.tr: n. 图画；绘画；制图； v. 提取；吸引；画；“draw”的现在分词；
words.ex: The child made a drawing of a cat.
words.ex_cn: 孩子画了一幅猫的图画。
words.en: A drawing is a picture made with a pencil, pen, or crayon rather than paint.

words.ex: I will visit you this weekend.
words.en: The weekend is Saturday and Sunday, the two days in the week when many people do not work.

words.ex: He plays football at weekends.
words.en: During the weekend; typically referring to Saturday and Sunday.

words.ex: I play soccer on weekends.
words.en: During the weekend, which is usually Saturday and Sunday.

words.ex: We go hiking at the weekend.
words.en: During the weekend; on Saturday and Sunday.

words.ex: I usually go hiking on the weekend.
words.en: During the weekend; at the weekend (used in American and British English respectively).

words.ex: Of course, I will help you with your homework.
words.en: Used to express agreement or to indicate that something is expected or obvious.

words.tr:
n. 商店；
v. 购物；
words.ex: I bought bread from the local shop.
words.ex_cn: 我从附近的商店买了面包。
words.en: A shop is a place where goods are sold; also, to shop means to visit shops in order to buy things.

words.ex: He plays table tennis every afternoon.
words.en: Table tennis, also known as ping-pong, is a sport in which two or four players hit a lightweight ball back and forth across a table using small rackets.

words.tr:
adv. 另外；其他；
adj. 别的；其他的；
words.ex: I want tea, else coffee.
words.ex_cn: 我想喝茶，另外也想喝咖啡。
words.en: In addition to what has already been mentioned or considered.

words.ex: There are a lot of books on the shelf.
words.en: A lot refers to a large number or amount of something. It can also mean a piece of land or someone's fate or destiny.

words.ex: He has a lot of books.
words.en: A large number or amount of something.

words.ex: There are lots of books on the shelf.
words.en: A large number or amount of something.

words.ex: Playing games with friends is fun.
words.ex_cn: 和朋友一起玩游戏很有趣。
words.en: If you say that someone is fun or that they are fun to be with, you mean that you enjoy being with them because they make you feel happy and amused.

words.ex: Our team won the soccer match.
words.ex_cn: 我们的团队赢得了足球比赛。
words.en: A team is a group of people who play a particular sport or game together against other similar groups of people.

words.ex: We should talk about the plan for tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我们应该谈谈明天的计划。
words.en: To discuss or mention a particular subject.

words.ex: Everyone is talking of the new movie.
words.ex_cn: 大家都在谈论这部电影。
words.en: To speak about someone or something; to mention someone or something in conversation.

words.tr:
v. 相配；
n. 比赛；
words.ex: The curtains match the sofa.
words.en: A match is a competition or game in which people or teams compete against each other. It can also refer to a small stick that produces a flame when rubbed against a rough surface, used for lighting a fire, cigarette, etc. Additionally, it can mean a person or thing that is equal to another in quality, strength, or suitability.

words.ex: The firefighter is a hero for saving the child.
words.ex_cn: 消防员救了孩子，是个英雄。
words.en: A hero is a person who is admired for their courage, outstanding achievements, or noble qualities.

words.tr:
pron. 哪个；
adj. 哪个的；
words.ex: Which book do you want to read?
words.en: You use which in questions when there are two or more possible answers or alternatives.

words.tr:
adj. 最好的；
adv. 最好地；
n. 最佳物；佼佼者；最高水平；
words.ex: He is the best player on the team.
words.en: Of the most excellent, effective, or desirable type or quality.

words.tr:
adv. 如此；这么；很；也
conj. 所以
words.ex: I am so tired after school.
words.en: used to emphasize the degree or extent of something

words.ex: He likes biology because it teaches about animals and plants.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢生物学，因为它教关于动物和植物的知识。
words.en: Biology is the science which is concerned with the study of living things.

words.ex: He loves geography and learns about countries and rivers.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢地理学，学习各国和河流的知识。
words.en: The study of the physical features of the earth and its atmosphere, and of human activity as it affects and is affected by these, including the distribution of populations and resources, land use, and industries.

words.ex: He likes to read history books about ancient Rome.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢阅读关于古罗马的历史书籍。
words.en: History is the study of past events, particularly in human affairs.

words.tr:
n. 日期；年代；约会；枣子；枣椰树；
v. 标日期；约会；追溯到；过时；
words.ex: What is the date today?
words.en: A date is a specific day of the month or year, which can be identified by a particular name or number.

words.tr: n. 会议；会面； v. 遇见；见面；“meet”的现在分词；
words.ex: The meeting starts at 9 a.m.
words.en: A meeting is an event in which a group of people come together to discuss things or make decisions.

words.ex: The train leaves at five o'clock.
words.en: You use o'clock after numbers from one to twelve to say what time it is. For example, if you say that it is 9 o'clock, you mean that it is nine hours after midnight or nine hours after noon.

words.tr:
adj. 好的；不错的；可以的
int. 好的；可以
words.ex: The food is OK.
words.en: An expression meaning 'all right' or 'acceptable', used to indicate approval or agreement.

words.tr:
adv. 好的；可以；
adj. 好的；
words.ex: Okay, I will do it now.
words.en: Used to express agreement or acceptance.

words.ex: He closed the gate before it rained.
words.en: A gate is a structure like a door which is used at the entrance to a field, a garden, or the grounds of a building.

words.tr:
v. 展示；表明；给...看；
n. 节目；演出；展览会；表现；
words.ex: He shows his photos to his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他向朋友们展示他的照片。
words.en: To show something means to make it visible or to allow it to be seen. It can also refer to a performance or exhibition intended to entertain or educate.

words.tr:
prep. 在…周围；环绕；
adv. 大约；到处；在附近；环绕；
words.ex: The children are running around the tree.
words.en: In a position or direction surrounding, or in the vicinity of, a particular place or thing.

words.ex: He showed me around the school.
words.en: to guide someone on a tour of a place, making them familiar with it

words.tr:
n. 前面；前线；
adj. 前面的；
words.ex: The front of the house has a big garden.
words.ex_cn: 房子的前面有一个大花园。
words.en: The front is the part of something that faces forward or is the most important or prominent part.

words.ex: The cat is sitting in front of the house.
words.en: If someone or something is in front of a particular thing, they are facing it, ahead of it, or close to the front part of it.

words.tr: n. 建筑物；楼房； v. 建筑；“build”的现在分词；
words.ex: The tall building has 20 floors.
words.en: A building is a structure that has a roof and walls and stands more or less permanently in one place.

words.tr: n. 地面；土地；场地；根据； v. 磨碎；“grind”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The children are playing on the ground.
words.en: The solid surface of the earth; the basis or foundation for something; to restrict an aircraft or pilot from flying.

words.tr: phrase. 一楼；底层；有利地位
words.ex: The shop is on the ground floor.
words.en: The ground floor of a building is the floor that is level or almost level with the ground outside.

words.tr: phrase. 一楼（在英式英语中指二楼，美式英语中指地面层以上的第一层）
words.ex: My office is on the first floor.
words.en: In British English, the first floor is the floor of a building which is one level above the ground floor. In American English, the first floor is the same as the ground floor.

words.tr: adj. 明亮的；鲜艳的；聪明的；
words.ex: The room is bright because of the big window.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间因为大窗户而很明亮。
words.en: Emitting or reflecting much light; shining.

words.ex: This house has a modern design.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子具有现代的设计。
words.en: Modern means relating to the present time, for example the present decade or present century.

words.ex: The students gathered in the hall for the assembly.
words.en: A hall is a large room or building which is used for public events such as concerts, exhibitions, and meetings.

words.ex: He writes in his diary every night.
words.en: A diary is a book in which you write down your personal experiences and thoughts each day.

words.ex: He looks at the picture carefully.
words.en: To direct your eyes towards someone or something so that you can see them.

words.ex: He paints the wall blue.
words.en: A wall is a vertical structure, often made of stone or brick, that divides or encloses an area of land.

words.tr: phrase. 让我想想；让我看看
words.ex: Let me see, I think I left my keys on the table.
words.ex_cn: 让我想想，我觉得我把钥匙放在桌子上了。
words.en: A request for permission to examine something or to pause for consideration.

words.ex: We play soccer after class.
words.en: After class refers to the time following a class or lesson when students are free to engage in other activities.

words.tr:
v. 原谅；宽恕；请再说一遍
n. 原谅；宽恕
words.ex: Can you pardon me for being late?
words.en: If you pardon someone, you forgive them for something they have done wrong. If someone is pardoned, they are officially forgiven for a crime they have committed.

words.tr:
n. 电话；
v. 打电话；
words.ex: I lost my phone yesterday.
words.en: A phone is a piece of equipment that you use to talk to someone who is in another place.

words.ex: He picked up the telephone to call his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起电话给妈妈打电话。
words.en: A telephone is a device that you use to speak to someone in another place by dialing a number. It converts sound into electrical signals that can be sent over long distances.

words.tr: phrase. 用电话交谈；在通话
words.ex: He is talking on the phone with his mother.
words.en: Using the telephone to communicate with someone.

words.tr: 介词短语，表示从某个起点到某个终点，可用于时间、地点、数量、范围等
words.ex: The store is open from nine to five.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店从九点开到五点。
words.en: Indicating the starting point and the ending point of a range or movement.

words.tr: v. 做（某个动作）；接受；带领；花费；拿；乘坐；
words.ex: He takes a deep breath before speaking.
words.ex_cn: 他在说话前深吸一口气。
words.en: To lay hold of (something) with one's hands; reach for and hold.

words.ex: I get up at seven o'clock every morning.
words.en: To rise from bed after sleeping; to stand up; to increase in amount or level.

words.ex: Children go to school every day.
words.en: To attend an educational institution for the purpose of learning.

words.tr: abbr. 上午；午前；“ante meridiem”的缩写
words.ex: He wakes up at 6 a.m. every day.
words.en: used when referring to a time between midnight and noon

words.tr: abbr. 下午；午后；“post meridiem”的缩写
words.ex: The meeting starts at 3 p.m.
words.en: Used after a time to indicate that it is in the afternoon or evening.

words.ex: He reads books in the reading room.
words.en: A room set aside for reading, especially in a library or educational institution.

words.tr:
adv. 只；仅仅；只有；
adj. 唯一的；仅有的；
words.ex: He eats only apples for breakfast.
words.en: You use only to indicate the one thing that is true, appropriate, or important in a particular situation, in contrast to all the other things that are not true, appropriate, or important.

words.tr:
adj. 确信；必定的；
adv. 当然；当然可以；
words.ex: I am sure he will come tomorrow.
words.en: If you are sure that something is true, you are certain that it is true. If you say that something is sure to happen, you mean that it will definitely happen.

words.tr:
n. 种类；
adj. 善良的；和蔼的；
words.ex: There are many kinds of fruits in the market.
words.ex_cn: 市场上有各种各样的水果。
words.en: If you describe someone as kind, you mean that they are gentle, caring, and helpful.

words.tr: phrase. 各种各样的；各种类型的
words.ex: He collects all kinds of stamps.
words.ex_cn: 他收集各种各样的邮票。
words.en: A phrase used to indicate a variety of different types or kinds of something.

words.ex: I will borrow a book from the library.
words.ex_cn: 我将从图书馆借一本书。
words.en: To take and use something that belongs to someone else with the intention of returning it.

words.ex: A is the first letter in the English alphabet.
words.ex_cn: A 是英语字母表中的第一个字母。
words.en: A letter is a written message that can be handwritten or printed on paper. It is usually sent in an envelope by post or messenger.

words.tr:
adj. 很少；不多；
pron. 很少人；一些；
n. 几个；
words.ex: Few people came to the meeting.
words.en: A few means a small number of things or people. When you say there are a few of something, you mean there are not many of them.

words.ex: I have a few apples on the table.
words.en: A small number of things or people.

words.ex: He walked away from the house.
words.en: If someone or something moves or is moved away from a place, they move or are moved so that they are no longer there.

words.ex: The village is far away from the city.
words.en: At, to, or from a great distance in space or time.

words.ex: He goes to school on foot.
words.en: By walking.

words.tr: phrase. 一切顺利；祝你好运
words.ex: All the best in your new job!
words.ex_cn: 祝你在新工作中一切顺利！
words.en: a phrase used to wish someone success or good luck in the future.

words.ex: He wakes up at six every morning.
words.en: To wake means to stop sleeping or to cause someone to stop sleeping. It can also refer to the trail left by a moving ship.

words.ex: I wake up at seven every morning.
words.en: To stop sleeping and become conscious, or to make someone stop sleeping.

words.ex: I shall go to the park tomorrow.
words.en: used to indicate future action or intention, or to express obligation or necessity

words.ex: The children played on the green hill.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在绿色的丘陵上玩耍。
words.en: A hill is a piece of land that is higher than the land that surrounds it, but not as high as a mountain.

words.ex: He seldom eats fast food.
words.en: If something seldom happens, it happens only occasionally.

words.tr:
adv. 出去；外出；离开；
v. 揭露；使熄灭；驱逐；
prep. 向外；在外面；
adj. 出局的；外面的；
words.ex: He walked out of the room.
words.en: If someone is out, they are not at home or not at their usual place of work. If something is out, it is not in its usual place. If you are out of something, you no longer have any of it. If something is out, it is available to the public. If a light or fire is out, it is no longer burning or shining. If a ball in a game is out, it is outside the area where it should be. If a secret is out, it is known by people who were not supposed to know it. If you are out, you are no longer involved in a competition or activity because you have been defeated or have decided to stop.

words.ex: They go out to watch a movie on weekends.
words.en: To leave a place, especially one's home, for a short time, usually for a specific purpose such as entertainment or socializing.

words.ex: I have breakfast at 7 a.m. every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上七点吃早餐。
words.en: To eat the first meal of the day, typically in the morning.

words.ex: I have lunch at noon every day.
words.en: To eat the midday meal.

words.ex: They have dinner at 7 p.m. every day.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天晚上7点吃晚饭。
words.en: To eat the main meal of the day, typically in the evening.

words.tr:
v. 需要；
n. 需要；
words.ex: I need help with my homework.
words.en: If you need something, you must have it because it is essential.

words.tr:
n. 剩余部分；其他；休息；
v. （使）休息；（使）倚靠；停留在；
words.ex: He ate the first slice and left the rest for his sister.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了第一块，把剩下的留给了他妹妹。
words.en: To rest means to cease work or movement in order to relax, sleep, or recover strength. It can also refer to the remaining part of something.

words.tr: adv. 仅仅；就；只是；刚刚；恰好；
words.ex: He just wants to sleep.
words.en: Used to indicate that something is exactly the case or is happening at this moment.

words.tr: 玩得高兴，过得快活; 耍笑; 玩耍
words.ex: They have fun playing soccer after school.
words.ex_cn: 他们放学后踢足球很开心。
words.en: to enjoy oneself; to experience pleasure and enjoyment

words.ex: I have lessons every Monday.
words.en: To attend or participate in classes or educational sessions.

words.ex: She attends an after-school art class.
words.ex_cn: 她参加一个课外美术班。
words.en: After-school is used to describe activities that take place after the school day has ended.

words.ex: The school organized a fun activity for the students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为学生们组织了一场有趣的活动。
words.en: An activity is something that you spend time doing.

words.ex: He finished his homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭前完成了家庭作业。
words.en: Homework is school work that teachers give to pupils to do at home in the evening or at the weekend.

words.ex: He goes to bed at nine every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上九点上床睡觉。
words.en: To go to bed means to lie down in a bed in order to sleep.

words.ex: She usually walks to school.
words.en: Under normal conditions; generally.

words.ex: He has never been to Japan.
words.en: At no time in the past or future; on no occasion; not ever.

words.ex: He is late for school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都上学迟到。
words.en: To arrive somewhere after the expected or usual time.

words.tr:
v. 开始；
n. 开始；
words.ex: He starts his day with coffee.
words.en: To begin doing something; to cause something to begin or to operate; to set out on a journey.

words.tr: n. 四分之一；季度；一刻钟；地区；方向；
words.ex: He ate a quarter of the pizza.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了四分之一的比萨。
words.en: A quarter is one of four equal parts of something, or a period of three months.

words.tr:
n. 过去；昔日；
adj. 过去的；昔日的；
prep. 超过；晚于；
adv. 经过；
words.ex: He never talks about the past.
words.en: The past is the time before the present, and the things that have happened.

words.ex: I eat breakfast in the morning.
words.en: During the early part of the day, from sunrise to noon.

words.ex: We play soccer in the afternoon.
words.en: In the afternoon refers to the period of time between noon and evening.

words.ex: We eat dinner in the evening.
words.en: During the period of time at the end of the day, usually from about 6 p.m. to bedtime.

words.tr:
adj. 第一的；
adv. 首先；第一；
n. 第一；
words.ex: He got the first prize in the race.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中获得了第一名。
words.en: A fist is the hand with the fingers bent in towards the palm and held tightly there, typically in order to strike a blow or grasp something.

words.tr:
v. 聊天；
n. 聊天；
words.ex: They chat every evening after dinner.
words.en: To talk in a friendly and informal way.

words.tr:
adj. 每个的；各自的；
pron. 每个；各自；
words.ex: Each student has a book.
words.en: Used to refer to every one of a group or series considered individually.

words.tr:
adj. 其他的；
pron. 其他（人或物）；
words.ex: I have two books; one is mine, and the other is my friend's.
words.ex_cn: 我有两本书，一本是我的，另一本是我朋友的。
words.en: Used to refer to a person or thing that is different or distinct from one already mentioned or known about.

words.ex: They help each other with homework.
words.en: You use each other when you are saying that each member of a group does something to or for the other members.

words.ex: He practises piano every day.
words.en: To do something repeatedly in order to improve your skill at it.

words.ex: They have a good time at the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们在公园玩得很开心。
words.en: to enjoy oneself; to spend time in a pleasant way

words.tr:
v. 祝愿；希望；
n. 祝福；愿望；
words.ex: I wish you a happy birthday.
words.en: If you wish to do something or you wish to have it done for you, you want to do it or have it done.

words.ex: He would help you if he could.
words.ex_cn: 如果他能的话，他会帮你。
words.en: Used to indicate a hypothetical situation or a future event that was considered likely or planned in the past.

words.ex: I would like a cup of tea.
words.en: If you say that you would like something or would like to do something, you are indicating a wish or desire that you have.

words.ex: She enjoys simple life in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢乡村里的简单生活。
words.en: Life is the existence of an individual human being or animal.

words.tr: n. 生活；生命；“life”的复数； v. 居住；生活；
words.ex: Their lives are simple but happy.
words.ex_cn: 他们的生活简单但幸福。
words.en: The condition that distinguishes animals and plants from inorganic matter, including the capacity for growth, reproduction, functional activity, and continual change preceding death; the existence of an individual human being or animal.

words.ex: He loves roller skating in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在公园里滑旱冰。
words.en: The activity or sport of moving over the ground or a surface on roller skates.

words.ex: He won the lottery by pure luck.
words.ex_cn: 他纯粹是靠运气中了彩票。
words.en: Luck is the force that causes things, especially good things, to happen to you by chance and not as a result of your own efforts or abilities.

words.ex: We visited a museum last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末参观了一个博物馆。
words.en: A museum is a building where a large number of interesting and valuable objects, such as works of art or historical items, are kept, studied, and displayed to the public.

words.ex: I visited my grandparents twice last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年我去了祖父母家两次。
words.en: Two times; on two occasions.

words.tr:
n. 野餐；
v. 去野餐；
words.ex: We had a picnic in the park on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在周日去公园野餐了。
words.en: A picnic is a meal eaten outdoors, especially in the countryside, usually as part of a trip or outing.

words.tr:
conj. 一旦；一…便；
adv. 曾经；一次；
words.ex: Once you finish your homework, you can play.
words.ex_cn: 一旦你完成作业，就可以玩了。
words.en: At one time in the past; formerly.

words.ex: He dislikes eating broccoli.
words.en: If you dislike someone or something, you consider them to be unpleasant and do not like them.

words.tr:
n. 原因；理由；理性；
v. 推理；推断；
words.ex: The reason for his absence is sickness.
words.en: A reason is an explanation or justification for an action, belief, or occurrence.

words.ex: I am ready for the test.
words.en: If you are ready, you are prepared for something or are in a suitable state to do or deal with it.

words.tr: 短语动词. 为某事做好准备
words.ex: We get ready for school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我们每天早上为上学做准备。
words.en: To prepare oneself for a particular event or situation.

words.ex: I learn English every day.
words.en: To gain knowledge or skill by studying, practicing, being taught, or experiencing something.

words.ex: He loves the world and wants to travel everywhere.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱这个世界，想要去所有地方旅行。
words.en: The earth, together with all of its countries, peoples, and natural features.

words.ex: We celebrate my birthday with cake and friends.
words.ex_cn: 我们用蛋糕和朋友庆祝我的生日。
words.en: To celebrate means to mark a special day, event, or occasion with festivities or ceremonies. It can also mean to praise or honor someone or something.

words.tr:
v. 猜测；猜想；
n. 猜测；猜想；
words.ex: I guess it will rain tomorrow.
words.en: If you guess something, you give an answer or provide an opinion which may not be true because you do not have definite knowledge about the matter concerned.

words.tr:
n. 连衣裙；衣服；
v. 穿衣服；
words.ex: She wore a red dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条红色连衣裙去参加派对。
words.en: A dress is a piece of clothing for women or girls that covers the body and part or all of the legs. To dress means to put clothes on yourself or someone else.

words.tr: phrase. 装扮；穿上盛装；乔装打扮
words.ex: The children dress up as pirates for Halloween.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在万圣节打扮成海盗。
words.en: To wear formal or special clothes for a particular occasion or to make something or someone look more attractive by adding decorations or details.

words.tr:
adv. 如同；和…一样
prep. 作为；如同
conj. 由于；像；当…时；尽管
words.ex: He runs as fast as a cheetah.
words.en: used to compare two things, to show that they are similar in some way; used to introduce the reason for something; used to mean 'in the role of'

words.ex: The children said they saw a ghost in the old house.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们说他们在老房子里看到了一个鬼。
words.en: A ghost is the spirit of a dead person that some people believe they can see or feel.

words.ex: We buy gifts for Christmas.
words.en: Christmas is the period around the 25th of December when Christians celebrate the birth of Jesus Christ.

words.ex: The town holds a music festival every summer.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇每年夏天都举办音乐节。
words.en: A festival is an organized series of events such as musical concerts or drama productions, often happening annually in the same place.

words.ex: He was late because the bus was slow.
words.ex_cn: 他迟到了，因为公交车很慢。
words.en: You use 'because' when stating the reason for something.

words.tr:
adj. 目前的；在场的；
n. 目前；礼物；
v. 呈现；提出；
words.ex: The present situation is very difficult.
words.en: If you say that someone is present at an event, you mean that they are there.

words.ex: We work together every day.
words.en: If people do something together, they do it with each other.

words.ex: We get together every weekend to play basketball.
words.ex_cn: 我们每周末聚在一起打篮球。
words.en: If people get together, they meet in order to spend time with each other.

words.ex: She eats a moon cake during the Mid-Autumn Festival.
words.en: A traditional Chinese pastry eaten during the Mid-Autumn Festival, typically round in shape to symbolize the full moon.

words.tr:
adj. 满的；充满的；
adv. 完全地；
words.ex: The glass is full of water.
words.en: Containing or holding as much or as many as possible; having no empty space.

words.ex: He moved to the USA last year.
words.en: The United States of America, a federal republic in North America.

words.tr: phrase. 美国；美利坚合众国
words.ex: He lives in the United States of America.
words.en: The United States of America, commonly known as the United States or America, is a country primarily located in North America. It consists of 50 states, a federal district, five major unincorporated territories, nine Minor Outlying Islands, and 326 Indian reservations.

words.ex: He wore a scary mask at the Halloween party.
words.ex_cn: 他在万圣节派对上戴了一个可怕的面具。
words.en: A mask is a piece of cloth or other material that you wear over your face to hide or protect it.

words.tr:
n. 油漆；绘画颜料；
v. 刷油漆；画；
words.ex: The paint on the wall is peeling.
words.en: Paint is a coloured liquid that you put onto a surface with a brush in order to protect the surface or to make it look nice, or to produce a picture.

words.ex: He carved a big pumpkin for Halloween.
words.ex_cn: 他为万圣节雕刻了一个大南瓜。
words.en: A pumpkin is a large, round, orange vegetable with a thick skin.

words.ex: The children carried paper lanterns at the festival.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在节日上提着纸灯笼。
words.en: A lantern is a lamp in a container that has a handle for holding or hanging it, and it usually has a protective case around the flame or bulb.

words.tr:
conj. 在…的时候；
adv. 什么时候；
words.ex: I eat breakfast when I wake up.
words.en: You use when to ask about the time that something happened or will happen.

words.tr:
prep. 在（或向）…内；
n. 内部；里面；
adv. 在（或向）里面；
adj. 内部的；里面的；
words.ex: The keys are inside the drawer.
words.en: The inside of something is the part that is normally enclosed or hidden by its outer surface.

words.tr:
v. 击；撞；
n. 撞击；敲击；
words.ex: He knock on the door.
words.en: To strike a surface noisily to attract attention, especially when waiting to be let in through a door.

words.ex: He knocks on the door before entering.
words.en: To strike a door with the knuckles, a hard object, etc., in order to attract attention or gain entry.

words.ex: He shouted for help when he fell.
words.en: If you shout, you say something very loudly, usually because you want people a long distance away to hear you or because you are angry.

words.tr: phrase. 不给糖就捣蛋（万圣节儿童挨家要糖果的习俗）
words.ex: The children say 'trick or treat' on Halloween.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在万圣节时说‘不给糖就捣蛋’。
words.en: A Halloween practice in which children wearing costumes go from door to door asking for treats with the question 'Trick or treat?' and threatening to play a trick on those who refuse.

words.ex: If it rains, we will stay home.
words.ex_cn: 如果下雨，我们就待在家里。
words.en: You use if in conditional sentences to introduce the circumstances in which an event or situation might happen, might be happening, or might have happened.

words.tr:
v. 治疗；对待；
n. 款待；
words.ex: The doctor will treat his fever with medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生会用药物治疗他的发烧。
words.en: If you treat someone or something in a particular way, you behave towards them or deal with them in that way.

words.ex: He showed me the trick to solve this math problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他给我展示了快速解决这道数学题的诀窍。
words.en: A trick is a clever or deceitful action intended to deceive or outwit someone.

words.tr:
adj. 特别的；特殊的；
n. 特价；特色菜；专车；特别的物品；
words.ex: This is a special day for me.
words.ex_cn: 这一天对我来说很特别。
words.en: Something that is special is different from normal things, or is considered to be better than normal things.

words.ex: He answered all the questions correctly.
words.ex_cn: 他全部答对了这些问题。
words.en: Questions are sentences or phrases that ask for information, opinions, or instructions.

words.ex: She made dumplings for dinner.
words.en: A small lump of dough that is cooked and served with a meal, often as a side dish.

words.tr: phrase. 粽子（用糯米包裹馅料并用粽叶捆扎而成的传统中式食品）
words.ex: She eats a rice dumpling during the Dragon Boat Festival.
words.ex_cn: 她在端午节吃一个粽子。
words.en: A traditional Chinese food made of glutinous rice stuffed with different fillings and wrapped in bamboo leaves, typically eaten during the Dragon Boat Festival.

words.tr: n. 祖父；祖母；外祖父；外祖母
words.ex: My grandparent lives in a small village.
words.ex_cn: 我的祖父住在一个小村庄里。
words.en: A grandparent is the parent of your father or mother.

words.tr:
adj. 其他的；
pron. 其他（人或物）；
words.ex: I have two books; one is mine, and the other is my friend's.
words.ex_cn: 我有两本书，一本是我的，另一本是我朋友的。
words.en: Used to refer to a person or thing that is different or distinct from one already mentioned or known about.

words.ex: This thing is very useful.
words.en: An object, fact, affair, circumstance, or concept considered as being a separate entity.

words.ex: The lion roars loudly in the wild.
words.en: A lion is a large wild animal of the cat family, which is found in Africa. Lions have yellowish fur, and male lions have a mane.

words.ex: The children watched the lion dance during the festival.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在节日里观看了舞狮。
words.en: A lion dance is a form of traditional dance in Chinese culture and other Asian countries in which performers mimic a lion's movements in a lion costume to bring good luck and fortune.

words.ex: Children laughed as the firework lit up the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们看着焰火点亮夜空，哈哈大笑。
words.en: A firework is a small device that is lit to produce a display of light, noise, and smoke, often used in celebrations.

words.ex: I want to find out why he is late.
words.ex_cn: 我想弄清楚他为什么迟到。
words.en: To discover a fact or piece of information, often by making an effort to do so.

words.tr:
adv. 更加；
adj. 更多的；
pron. 更多的人或物；
words.ex: She wants to learn more about science.
words.en: You use 'more' to indicate that there is a greater amount of something than before or than average, or than something else. You can use 'more' with a noun to indicate that there is a greater amount of it than before or than average, or than something else.

words.tr: n. 无线电；无线电广播；收音机；
words.ex: He listens to the radio every morning.
words.en: A radio is the equipment that you use to listen to broadcasts of news, music, and other programs.

words.ex: He takes photos of the sunset every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上拍夕阳的照片。
words.en: To capture images using a camera.

words.ex: He sleeps at night.
words.en: During the night; in the nighttime.

words.tr:
v. 展示；表明；给...看；
n. 节目；演出；展览会；表现；
words.ex: He shows his photos to his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他向朋友们展示他的照片。
words.en: To show something means to make it visible or to allow it to be seen. It can also refer to a performance or exhibition intended to entertain or educate.

words.ex: He seems tired after work.
words.en: If something seems to be a particular way, it appears to be that way.

words.ex: The two apples are different.
words.en: not the same as another or each other; unlike in nature, form, or quality

words.tr:
prep. 在…周围；环绕；
adv. 大约；到处；在附近；环绕；
words.ex: The children are running around the tree.
words.en: In a position or direction surrounding, or in the vicinity of, a particular place or thing.

words.ex: It is important to eat healthy food.
words.en: Something that is important is very significant, is highly valued, or is necessary.

words.tr:
adv. 最；
pron. 大部分；
adj. 最多的；大多数的；
words.ex: He is most tired after work.
words.en: You use most to refer to the majority of a group of things or people or the largest part of something.

words.tr:
adv. 离；断开；
prep. 离开；脱落；
adj. 空闲的；远离的；
int. 走开；
words.ex: The boat moved off from the shore.
words.en: If something is off, it is not on or is not being used.

words.tr: phrase. 放出；饶恕；准许...暂停工作
words.ex: He let off a loud whistle to get attention.
words.ex_cn: 他大声吹口哨以引起注意。
words.en: To allow someone to escape punishment, or to release something such as steam or a bomb.

words.tr: phrase. 出发；动身；使爆炸；引起
words.ex: He set off early to avoid traffic.
words.ex_cn: 他早早出发以避开交通拥堵。
words.en: To begin a journey or to cause something to start or happen.

words.ex: He bought a packet of sugar.
words.en: A packet is a small container in which a quantity of something is sold. Packets are either small boxes made of thin cardboard, or bags or envelopes made of paper or plastic.

words.ex: He gave me a red packet during New Year.
words.ex_cn: 新年期间他给了我一个红包。
words.en: A red packet is a monetary gift which is given during holidays or special occasions in Chinese culture.

words.ex: He lives a 24/7 lifestyle, working and texting all day and night.
words.ex_cn: 他过着24/7的生活方式，整天整夜地工作和发信息。
words.en: The way in which a person lives is their lifestyle.

words.ex: We eat lunch at noon.
words.en: Noon is the middle of the day, 12 o'clock in the daytime.

words.ex: He eats a hamburger for lunch.
words.en: A hamburger is a cooked patty of ground meat, usually beef, placed inside a sliced bread roll or bun.

words.ex: She keeps the room clean every day.
words.en: To continue to have or hold something; to maintain a condition or position.

words.ex: She squeezed a lemon into her water.
words.ex_cn: 她把一个柠檬挤进水里。
words.en: A lemon is a bright yellow fruit with very sour juice. Lemons grow on trees in warm countries.

words.ex: He eats a watermelon every summer.
words.en: A watermelon is a large, round fruit with green skin, pink flesh, and black seeds.

words.ex: He ate a piece of chocolate after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后吃了一块巧克力。
words.en: A food preparation in the form of a paste or solid block made from roasted and ground cacao seeds, typically sweetened.

words.ex: He eats beef for dinner every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日吃牛肉当晚餐。
words.en: Beef is the meat from a cow, bull, or ox. When people beef about something, they complain about it.

words.ex: He eats a carrot every day.
words.en: A carrot is a long, thin, orange-colored vegetable that grows underground.

words.ex: He eats pork for dinner every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日吃猪肉当晚餐。
words.en: Pork is meat from a pig, usually fresh and not smoked or salted.

words.tr:
adj. 甜的；悦人的；
n. 糖果；
words.ex: The cake is sweet and delicious.
words.en: Sweet is used to describe something that tastes of sugar or is pleasant in a way that is reminiscent of sugar. It can also describe something that is pleasing to the senses other than taste, such as a sound or smell, or something that is kind and gentle.

words.ex: The child ate a piece of candy after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 孩子晚饭后吃了一块糖果。
words.en: Candy is a sweet food made from sugar or chocolate, often eaten as a treat.

words.ex: He eats meat every day.
words.en: Meat is the flesh of an animal that is eaten as food.

words.ex: I ate an apple as a snack after school.
words.ex_cn: 我放学后吃了一个苹果当小吃。
words.en: A snack is a small amount of food that is eaten between meals.

words.ex: Good food and sleep help maintain health.
words.ex_cn: 良好的饮食和睡眠有助于保持健康。
words.en: The condition of a person's body or mind, especially in terms of the presence or absence of illnesses, injuries, or impairments.

words.tr:
v. 符合；合身；
adj. 健康的；适合的；
words.ex: This shirt fits me well.
words.en: If something fits, it is the right size and shape to go onto a person's body or onto a particular object.

words.ex: He runs every morning to keep fit.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上跑步以保持健康。
words.en: To maintain one's health and physical condition through regular exercise and a healthy diet.

words.ex: We had a quick meal at noon.
words.ex_cn: 我们在中午吃了一顿简单的饭。
words.en: A meal is an occasion when people sit down to eat food, especially breakfast, lunch, or dinner.

words.ex: She ate a ripe pear for snack.
words.ex_cn: 她吃了一个熟透的梨当零食。
words.en: A pear is a sweet, juicy fruit that is narrow at the top and wider at the bottom. It has a thin green or brown skin, and white flesh.

words.ex: He put sugar in his tea.
words.en: A sweet substance that is used to make food and drinks sweet. It is usually in the form of white or brown crystals.

words.ex: He brushed his tooth after breakfast.
words.en: One of the hard, white objects in the mouth that are used for biting and chewing.

words.ex: He brushed his teeth every morning.
words.en: The hard, white objects in the mouth that are used for biting and chewing.

words.tr: phrase. 电脑游戏；电子游戏
words.ex: He plays a computer game every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上玩电脑游戏。
words.en: A computer game is a game that you play on a computer, in which the pictures that appear on the screen are controlled by pressing keys or moving a joystick.

words.ex: He drinks cola every day.
words.en: A sweet, carbonated soft drink flavored with extracts from the kola nut and other flavorings.

words.tr:
n. 变化；变革；
v. 变化；变革；
words.ex: There was a big change in the weather.
words.ex_cn: 天气发生了很大的变化。
words.en: To make or become different; to alter or modify; to exchange or replace something with another.

words.tr:
n. 计划；打算；
v. 计划；打算；
words.ex: He made a plan to visit his grandparents.
words.ex_cn: 他制定了一个去看望祖父母的计划。
words.en: A plan is a detailed proposal for doing or achieving something.

words.tr: n. 水塘；水池；备用物资；美式撞球；
words.ex: The children play near the small pool.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在小水塘边玩耍。
words.en: A pool is a small area of still water, especially one that is artificially created.

words.ex: They swim in the swimming pool every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天早上在游泳池里游泳。
words.en: A swimming pool is a large container filled with water, designed for people to swim in.

words.tr:
n. 件；作品；片；块；
v. 拼凑；
words.ex: She bought a piece of cake.
words.en: A piece of something is an amount of it that has been broken off, torn off, or cut off.

words.tr: phrase. 一块；一张；一片；一件
words.ex: He ate a piece of bread.
words.en: A portion or part of something.

words.ex: The window is made of glass.
words.en: Glass is a hard, brittle substance, typically transparent or translucent, made by fusing sand with soda, lime, and sometimes other ingredients and cooling rapidly.

words.ex: She put the food on a clean plate.
words.ex_cn: 她把食物放在一个干净的盘子里。
words.en: A flat dish, typically circular and made of china, from which food is eaten or served.

words.ex: She added a little salt to the soup.
words.en: Salt is a white crystalline substance that is used for seasoning or preserving food. It is also used in various industrial processes.

words.ex: He drank water from a cup.
words.en: A cup is a small round container that you drink from. Cups usually have handles and are made from china or plastic.

words.ex: He bought two kilos of apples.
words.en: A kilo is a unit of measurement equal to 1,000 grams or approximately 2.2 pounds. It is commonly used to measure weight.

words.ex: The apple weighs one kilogram.
words.en: A kilogram is a unit of mass equal to one thousand grams.

words.ex: He put the milk in a carton.
words.ex_cn: 他把牛奶倒进了硬纸盒里。
words.en: A carton is a box or container usually made of cardboard or plastic, used for holding goods.

words.ex: He drank water from a bottle.
words.en: A bottle is a glass or plastic container in which drinks and other liquids are kept. Bottles are usually round with straight sides and a narrow top.

words.tr: adv. 较少地；更少地；“little”的比较级； adj. 更少的；“little”的比较级； pron. 较少；更少；
words.ex: He eats less sugar now.
words.en: You use less to indicate that there is a smaller amount of something than before or than average. You can use 'less' to indicate that something is smaller in size or degree than another thing.

words.ex: He is taller than his brother.
words.en: used to introduce the second element in a comparison

words.ex: He has less than five apples.
words.en: If something is less than a particular amount, it is not as much as that amount.

words.ex: He has more than three books.
words.en: Used to indicate that something is greater in amount, degree, or number than something else or than expected.

words.ex: He takes a walk after dinner.
words.en: To go for a walk, especially for pleasure or exercise.

words.tr:
adj. 总的；全部的；
n. 总计；总额；
v. 共计；总数达；
words.ex: The total cost is $50.
words.en: The whole amount or number; the sum total.

words.ex: The number on the door is 5.
words.en: A number is a word or symbol that represents an amount or a quantity.

words.tr:
n. 分数；得分；总谱；乐谱；
v. 得分；
words.ex: He got a high score on the math test.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学考试中得了高分。
words.en: If you score a particular amount or number in a game or test, you achieve that amount or number.

words.tr:
n. 要点；点；观点；分数；
v. 指出；指向；
words.ex: The main point of his speech was to save energy.
words.ex_cn: 他演讲的主要要点是节约能源。
words.en: A point is a particular place or position, or a detail or aspect of something. It can also refer to the sharp end of something, or a unit of scoring in games. As a verb, it means to direct someone's attention towards something by extending a finger or other object.

words.tr:
adv. 更加；
adj. 更多的；
pron. 更多的人或物；
words.ex: She wants to learn more about science.
words.en: You use 'more' to indicate that there is a greater amount of something than before or than average, or than something else. You can use 'more' with a noun to indicate that there is a greater amount of it than before or than average, or than something else.

words.tr:
n. 顺序；条理；命令；订单；(生物学的)目；
v. 订购；命令；点餐；整理；
words.ex: The books are in alphabetical order.
words.ex_cn: 这些书是按字母顺序排列的。
words.en: If you order someone to do something, you tell them to do it in a way that they have to obey. Order can also refer to the way things are arranged or a request to make or supply something.

words.ex: He looked at the menu and chose pasta.
words.ex_cn: 他看了菜单，选择了意大利面。
words.en: A menu is a list of the food that is available at a restaurant or café.

words.ex: He ate a bowl of beans for lunch.
words.en: A bean is a seed from one of several genera of the flowering plant family Fabaceae, which are used for human or animal food.

words.ex: All right, let's go now.
words.en: If you say that something is all right, you mean that it is satisfactory or acceptable.

words.tr:
n. 味觉；味道；品味；喜好；
v. 品尝；有…味道；
words.ex: My taste can detect sweet and sour flavors.
words.ex_cn: 我的味觉能分辨甜味和酸味。
words.en: The sensation of flavor perceived in the mouth and throat on contact with a substance.

words.ex: China uses a lot of energy from coal.
words.ex_cn: 中国使用大量煤炭能源。
words.en: Energy is the ability and strength to do active physical things and the feeling that you are full of physical power and life.

words.tr:
adj. 全部的；整体的；
n. 整个；全部；
words.ex: He ate the whole cake by himself.
words.ex_cn: 他一个人吃掉了整个蛋糕。
words.en: The whole of something is all of it.

words.ex: I went shopping for groceries yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天去购物买杂货了。
words.en: The activity of buying things from shops.

words.ex: He goes to the mall to buy clothes.
words.en: A mall is a large enclosed shopping area from which traffic is excluded.

words.tr: phrase. 商业区；大商场；大型购物中心
words.ex: We went to the shopping mall to buy clothes and eat dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我们去商业区买衣服和吃晚饭。
words.en: A shopping mall is a large building or group of buildings containing a variety of stores and often restaurants and other business establishments situated close together.

words.tr:
adv. 向下；
prep. 沿…向下；
adj. 向下的；沮丧的；
words.ex: The ball fell down.
words.en: Down is used to indicate movement from a higher to a lower position. It can also refer to a state of being less active or successful.

words.ex: I hate waking up early.
words.en: To hate someone or something means to feel intense or passionate dislike for them.

words.tr:
adv. 好；对；满意地；
int. （用于表示惊讶，疑虑，接受等）好；
n. 井；
adj. 健康的；
words.ex: She sings well.
words.en: In a good or satisfactory manner; in a thorough manner; in a manner that is appropriate or suitable.

words.ex: I need the money for the bill.
words.ex_cn: 我需要这笔钱来付账单。
words.en: Money is the coins or bank notes that you use to buy things, or the amount of these that you have.

words.ex: He lost his wallet on the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他在公交车上丢了钱包。
words.en: A wallet is a small flat folding case made of leather or plastic, in which you can keep banknotes, credit cards, and other small flat objects.

words.ex: He carries a bag to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天带一个包去学校。
words.en: To carry something means to move it while supporting it, especially in your hands or arms.

words.ex: He buys a novel at the bookshop.
words.ex_cn: 他在书店买了一本小说。
words.en: A shop where books are sold.

words.ex: She gave him a gift for his birthday.
words.ex_cn: 她送了他一份生日礼物。
words.en: A gift is something that you give someone as a present. It can also refer to a natural ability or talent.

words.tr: abbr. 激光唱片；光盘；“Compact Disc”的缩写
words.ex: I bought a cd of my favorite songs.
words.ex_cn: 我买了一张我最爱歌曲的激光唱片。
words.en: A chemical element (symbol Cd) that is a soft, bluish-white metal, often used in batteries and pigments, and is toxic.

words.ex: He plays music on a compact disc.
words.en: A compact disc is a small plastic disc on which music or other digital information is stored in the form of a pattern of metal-coated pits from which it can be read using laser light.

words.tr:
adj. 确信；必定的；
adv. 当然；当然可以；
words.ex: I am sure he will come tomorrow.
words.en: If you are sure that something is true, you are certain that it is true. If you say that something is sure to happen, you mean that it will definitely happen.

words.ex: Maybe it will rain tomorrow.
words.en: used to show that something is possible or that something might be true

words.ex: He is interested in math.
words.en: To have a feeling of curiosity or concern about something, wanting to learn or know more about it.

words.ex: He put a stamp on the envelope.
words.ex_cn: 他在信封上贴了一张邮票。
words.en: A stamp is a small piece of paper which you stick on an envelope or package before you post it to pay for the cost of the postage. It can also mean to bring down your foot heavily on the ground or to impress a pattern or mark on a surface.

words.ex: He collects stamps every week.
words.en: If you collect a number of things, you gather them together, usually because you want them for a particular purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 不客气；不用谢（用于回应别人的感谢）
words.ex: You're welcome.
words.en: A polite response used to acknowledge thanks or as a standalone greeting.

words.ex: The shopkeeper gave me a small discount.
words.en: A shopkeeper is a person who owns or manages a shop.

words.tr: phrase. 稍等一下；请稍等；马上就好
words.ex: Just a minute, I am coming.
words.en: A phrase used to ask someone to wait for a short period of time.

words.ex: Can you take a look at my homework?
words.ex_cn: 你能看一下我的作业吗？
words.en: To direct one's gaze in order to see someone or something.

words.tr:
n. 费用；代价；
v. 花费；
words.ex: The cost of the book is ten dollars.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的费用是十美元。
words.en: The amount of money that you need in order to buy, make, or do something.

words.ex: This shirt is cheap and nice.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫又便宜又好看。
words.en: If something is cheap, it costs less money than usual or than you expected.

words.tr:
adj. 最后的；最近的；
v. 持续；
adv. 最后；最近一次；
words.ex: This is the last chance to pass the exam.
words.ex_cn: 这是通过考试的最后机会。
words.en: Coming after all others in time or order; final.

words.tr: phrase. 发夹；用来固定头发的小夹子
words.ex: She put on a hair clip before school.
words.ex_cn: 她上学前戴了一个发夹。
words.en: A hair clip is a device used to hold hair in place.

words.tr:
v. 相配；
n. 比赛；
words.ex: The curtains match the sofa.
words.en: A match is a competition or game in which people or teams compete against each other. It can also refer to a small stick that produces a flame when rubbed against a rough surface, used for lighting a fire, cigarette, etc. Additionally, it can mean a person or thing that is equal to another in quality, strength, or suitability.

words.tr:
adj. 粉红色的；
n. 粉红色；
words.ex: The flower is pink.
words.en: Pink is a pale red color that is named after the flower of the same name. It is often associated with femininity and romance.

words.tr:
adv. 很；相当；
adj. 漂亮的；
words.ex: The movie was pretty good.
words.en: If you describe someone, especially a girl, as pretty, you mean that they are attractive in a delicate way without being truly beautiful.

words.tr:
adv. 足够地；充分地；
adj. 足够的；充足的；
int. 够了；
words.ex: He didn't run fast enough to win the race.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得不够快，没能赢得比赛。
words.en: as much or as many as required.

words.tr:
n. 变化；变革；
v. 变化；变革；
words.ex: There was a big change in the weather.
words.ex_cn: 天气发生了很大的变化。
words.en: To make or become different; to alter or modify; to exchange or replace something with another.

words.ex: This book is different from the one I read last week.
words.ex_cn: 这本书和我上周读的那本不一样。
words.en: not the same as another or each other; unlike in nature, form, or quality.

words.ex: He wrote his name on the paper.
words.en: A material made from cellulose pulp, derived mainly from wood, rags, and certain grasses, processed into flexible sheets or rolls by deposit from an aqueous suspension, and used chiefly for writing, printing, drawing, wrapping, and covering walls.

words.tr: n. 一件物品或商品；项目；一则；
words.ex: This item is on sale for $5.
words.ex_cn: 这件商品正在促销，售价5美元。
words.en: An item is one of a collection or list of objects.

words.ex: He wears a red t-shirt every day.
words.en: A T-shirt is a casual shirt with short sleeves and no collar, typically made of cotton.

words.tr: adj. 拙劣的；贫穷的；缺少的；可怜的；
words.ex: The acting in that movie was poor.
words.ex_cn: 那部电影的表演很拙劣。
words.en: If you describe someone as poor, you mean that they do not have enough money to live on or that they have very little money.

words.ex: The area of the rectangle is 20 square meters.
words.ex_cn: 这个矩形的面积是20平方米。
words.en: An area is a particular part of a place, piece of land, or country.

words.tr:
adv. 最；
pron. 大部分；
adj. 最多的；大多数的；
words.ex: He is most tired after work.
words.en: You use most to refer to the majority of a group of things or people or the largest part of something.

words.ex: He put the keys in his pocket.
words.ex_cn: 他把钥匙放进了口袋里。
words.en: A pocket is a small bag sewn into or on clothing so that you can carry small objects such as money or keys in it.

words.ex: He saves his pocket money to buy a bike.
words.ex_cn: 他把零花钱存起来买一辆自行车。
words.en: Pocket money is a small amount of money given to a child by their parents, typically on a regular basis, for them to spend as they wish.

words.tr:
n. 一双；一对；
v. （使）配对；
words.ex: He bought a pair of shoes for his son.
words.en: A pair of things are two things of the same size and shape that are intended to be used together, or that are regarded as a unit.

words.ex: He bought a pair of shoes.
words.en: used to describe two things that are the same or similar and are meant to be used together

words.ex: The size of the box is too big for the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子的大小对架子来说太大了。
words.en: The physical dimensions, proportions, magnitude, or extent of an object.

words.ex: She wants to try on the new dress.
words.en: To put on a piece of clothing to see if it fits or if you like it.

words.tr:
v. 符合；合身；
adj. 健康的；适合的；
words.ex: This shirt fits me well.
words.en: If something fits, it is the right size and shape to go onto a person's body or onto a particular object.

words.ex: The phone is expensive.
words.en: Costing a lot of money; having a high price.

words.tr:
adj. 又一个的；另一个的；
pron. 又一；另一；
words.ex: I need another cup of tea.
words.en: used to refer to an additional person or thing of the same type as one already mentioned or known about.

words.ex: The price of bread is too high.
words.en: The amount of money expected, required, or given in payment for something.

words.ex: He has a large house.
words.en: Something that is large is greater in size than usual or average.

words.tr:
n. 笔记；便条；音调；注释；语气；
v. 注意；记录；
words.ex: I took notes during the lecture.
words.ex_cn: 我在讲座期间做了笔记。
words.en: A note is a short piece of writing, a musical sound, or a piece of paper money. It can also mean to pay attention to something or to write something down.

words.ex: He waits for the bus at the bus stop.
words.en: A place on a bus route where buses regularly stop to pick up and drop off passengers.

words.ex: We ate dinner at a small restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 我们在一家小餐厅吃了晚饭。
words.en: A restaurant is a place where you can eat a meal and pay for it. In restaurants, your food is usually served to you at your table by a waiter or waitress.

words.tr:
n. 顶；顶部；顶端；
adj. 最高的；极棒的；
v. 胜过；超过；
words.ex: The top of the mountain is covered with snow.
words.en: The highest or uppermost point, part, or surface of something.

words.ex: She loves to follow the latest fashion.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢追随最新的时尚。
words.en: Fashion is a popular style of clothes, hair, etc. at a particular time.

words.ex: I think about my future every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天都会思考我的未来。
words.en: To consider or reflect on something.

words.ex: He spends money on books.
words.en: To spend means to use money to buy or pay for something, or to use time or energy in a particular way.

words.ex: He is lazy and doesn't like to do homework.
words.en: If someone is lazy, they are not willing to work or use any effort to do something.

words.tr: n. 宽松的女短衫；女衬衫
words.ex: She wears a white blouse to work.
words.ex_cn: 她上班穿一件白色上衣。
words.en: A blouse is a piece of clothing for women, which covers their body from the neck to the waist or slightly below, and which usually has long sleeves and buttons down the front.

words.ex: He ties his shoelaces before running.
words.en: To fasten or secure with or as if with a cord, rope, or strap.

words.ex: Can you lend me your pen?
words.ex_cn: 你能把你的笔借给我吗？
words.en: If you lend something you own to someone else, you allow them to have it or use it for a period of time, after which they must return it to you.

words.ex: The lady is waiting for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 这位女士正在等公交车。
words.en: A lady is a woman who is polite, well-mannered, and refined.

words.tr: n. 绅士；先生；有教养的人
words.ex: The gentleman smiled and held the door open.
words.ex_cn: 那位绅士微笑着为别人扶着门。
words.en: A gentleman is a man who is polite and well-educated, who has excellent manners and always behaves well.

words.tr: n. 风格；方式；样式；文体；
words.ex: Her dress has a unique style.
words.ex_cn: 她的裙子有一种独特的风格。
words.en: A particular kind, sort, or type, as with reference to form, appearance, or character.

words.ex: The trainer helped the athlete improve his speed.
words.ex_cn: 训练者帮助运动员提高了他的速度。
words.en: A trainer is someone who teaches skills to people or animals and prepares them for a job, activity, or sport.

words.ex: He wears a pair of sneakers to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天穿一双运动鞋去学校。
words.en: A sneaker is a type of soft shoe that you wear for sports or as informal wear.

words.ex: This chair is very comfortable.
words.en: If a piece of furniture or an item of clothing is comfortable, it makes you feel physically relaxed when you use it or wear it, for example because it is soft.

words.tr: adj. 流行的；受欢迎的；大众的；
words.ex: This song is popular among teenagers.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌在青少年中很流行。
words.en: liked, admired, or enjoyed by many people or by a particular person or group

words.ex: He is among the best students in class.
words.ex_cn: 他是班上最好的学生之一。
words.en: If you are among a group of things or people, you are surrounded by them or part of them.

words.tr:
adj. 紫色的；
n. 紫色；
words.ex: The flower is purple.
words.en: Purple is a color that is a mixture of red and blue.

words.tr:
adj. 灰色的；
n. 灰色；
words.ex: The sky is grey today.
words.en: Of a color intermediate between black and white, as of ashes or lead.

words.tr: adj. 聪明的；时髦的；衣冠楚楚的；
words.ex: He is a smart student who solves math problems quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个聪明的学生，能快速解决数学问题。
words.en: If you describe someone as smart, you mean that they are clean, tidy, and stylish in their appearance.

words.tr:
adj. 凉爽的；酷的；凉的；顶好的；
v. 变凉；
words.ex: The water is cool after the rain.
words.en: If you say that a person or their behavior is cool, you mean that they are calm and unemotional, especially in a difficult situation.

words.ex: She wore a dress made of cotton.
words.en: Cotton is a plant that produces a soft fiber which is used to make cloth or thread. Cotton is also the cloth or thread that is made from this fiber.

words.ex: She wore a warm scarf in winter.
words.ex_cn: 她在冬天戴了一条暖和的围巾。
words.en: A scarf is a piece of cloth that you wear around your neck or head, usually to keep yourself warm.

words.tr:
adj. 两者的；
pron. 两者；
conj. 不仅…而且...；
words.ex: Both books are on the table.
words.en: You use both to refer to two things or people together.

words.ex: He wears blue jeans every day.
words.en: Jeans are casual trousers made from denim or dungaree cloth.

words.ex: She wears a silk dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件丝绸连衣裙去参加派对。
words.en: A fine, strong, soft, lustrous fiber produced by silkworms in making cocoons and collected to make thread and fabric.

words.ex: She knits a sweater from wool.
words.en: Wool is the hair that grows on sheep and some other animals, which is used to make clothes, blankets, etc.

words.ex: He put the suitcase in the boot of the car.
words.ex_cn: 他把行李箱放进了汽车的后备箱里。
words.en: A boot is a type of shoe that covers the whole foot and the lower part of the leg. It can also mean to kick something forcefully or to start a computer.

words.ex: Both my mother and my father are teachers.
words.ex_cn: 我的妈妈和爸爸都是老师。
words.en: Used to emphasize that each of two things is true or happens, often to stress the inclusion of both items or ideas.

words.tr: 由……制成（表示材料，强调原材料未发生根本性变化）
words.ex: The table is made of wood.
words.en: If something is made of a particular material, that material was used to build it.

words.ex: I write to my friend every week.
words.ex_cn: 我每周给我的朋友写信。
words.en: Send a letter, email, or message to someone, especially to communicate information or ask for something.

words.ex: I wait for the bus every morning.
words.en: To remain in a place until a particular time or until something else happens.

words.ex: He looks for his keys every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都找他的钥匙。
words.en: To search for something or someone.

words.tr:
v. 躺；撒谎；
n. 谎言；
words.ex: The cat lies on the sofa.
words.en: If someone is lying, they are saying something which they know is not true.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 选择某物；争取某事物；喜欢或支持某事物
words.ex: He wants to go for the job.
words.en: To choose something; to try to achieve something; to like something.

words.tr:
v. 符合；合身；
adj. 健康的；适合的；
words.ex: This shirt fits me well.
words.en: If something fits, it is the right size and shape to go onto a person's body or onto a particular object.

words.tr: phrase. 适合的；胜任的；符合条件的
words.ex: This water is not fit for drinking.
words.en: Suitable or appropriate for a particular purpose or person.

words.tr: phrase. 想到；想起；有...的看法
words.ex: I think of my mom when I eat cookies.
words.ex_cn: 当我吃饼干时，我想起我的妈妈。
words.en: To have a particular idea or opinion about something or someone; to consider something or someone in a particular way.

words.ex: He put on his glove before playing baseball.
words.ex_cn: 他在打棒球前戴上了手套。
words.en: A glove is a piece of clothing which covers your hand and wrist and has individual sections for each finger.

words.ex: He bought a leather jacket for winter.
words.ex_cn: 他冬天买了一件皮夹克。
words.en: Leather is a material made from the skin of an animal by tanning or a similar process.

words.ex: The pillow is soft and comfortable.
words.en: Something that is soft is pleasant to touch, and not rough or hard.

words.tr:
adj. 平滑的；平坦的；
v. 使平滑；
words.ex: The glass surface is smooth.
words.en: Having an even and regular surface or consistency; free from projections, indentations, or roughness.

words.ex: The little girl has a lovely smile.
words.ex_cn: 这个小女孩有一个可爱的笑容。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as lovely, you mean that they are very beautiful and therefore pleasing to look at or be with.

words.ex: He wears a black hat every day.
words.en: A hat is a head covering which is worn for various reasons, including protection against weather conditions, ceremonial reasons such as university graduation, religious reasons, safety, or as a fashion accessory.

words.ex: He put on his jacket before going out.
words.en: A jacket is a short coat with long sleeves.

words.tr:
n. 特征；报刊特写；
v. 以…为特色；是…的重要组成；
words.ex: The main feature of this phone is its long battery life.
words.ex_cn: 这款手机的主要特征是续航时间长。
words.en: A feature of something is an interesting or important part or characteristic of it.

words.tr:
adj. 黑暗的；暗色的；深色的；
n. 黑暗；夜；暗色；
words.ex: The room was dark after the power went out.
words.en: The absence of light in a place is referred to as dark. It can also describe something that is not light in color, or something that is mysterious or difficult to understand.

words.tr:
n. 材料；原料；
adj. 物质的；
words.ex: The table is made of wood material.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是由木头材料制成的。
words.en: Material refers to the substance or substances from which a thing is made or can be made, or information or ideas for use in creating a book or other work.

words.tr:
n. 设计；图案；花样；企图；图谋；
v. 设计；计划；谋划；构思；
words.ex: The dress has a beautiful design.
words.ex_cn: 这条裙子有一个美丽的设计。
words.en: To design something means to plan and make a detailed drawing of it, or to plan and create something in a skillful or artistic way.

words.tr:
n. 模型；模特；模范；型号；
v. 将…做成模型；当模特；
words.ex: The architect built a model of the new building.
words.ex_cn: 建筑师制作了新大楼的模型。
words.en: A model is a person whose job is to wear and show new styles of clothes and other products, or a representation of something, often on a smaller scale, or a particular design or type of product.

words.ex: The package includes a free book.
words.ex_cn: 这个套餐包括一本免费的书。
words.en: If one thing includes another, it has the other thing as one of its parts.
